page: Microsoft Azure M96s_1_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the MSMediumMemoryv3 family. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor architecture and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V, this instance provides 96 dedicated vCPUs alongside 974.0 GB of system RAM. This configuration maintains a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of approximately 10.15 GB per core, positioning the server for memory-intensive enterprise tasks.

The instance operates without local disk storage or integrated graphics accelerators, requiring attached remote Premium Storage for all persistent system volumes and database files. The dedicated vCPU allocation provides predictable processor scheduling without resource contention from neighboring tenants. Given the absence of local ephemeral drives, storage throughput and latency depend strictly on external block storage configurations. Cost efficiency derives from consolidating heavy in-memory operations and massive concurrent threads within a single large-footprint host rather than managing sprawling distributed systems.

The M96s_1_v3 is structured specifically for large in-memory databases, enterprise-scale transactional systems, big data analytics engines, and intensive ETL pipelines that require nearly a terabyte of RAM to retain active working sets in memory.
description: Microsoft Azure M96s_1_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the MSMediumMemoryv3 family, designed for high-capacity memory workloads. Built on the x86_64 Intel platform and virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance features 96 dedicated vCPUs and 974.0 GB of RAM, yielding roughly 10.15 GB of memory per core. The server includes no integrated GPUs and provides no local storage disks, necessitating the use of external Premium Storage volumes for OS and data persistence. With dedicated compute allocation, it offers consistent execution across 96 parallel threads without host-level CPU contention. The high memory density suits memory-heavy architectures where large datasets must be retained in RAM to prevent disk bottlenecks. Consequently, the M96s_1_v3 fits large in-memory databases, enterprise relational database management systems, big data processing frameworks, and comprehensive ETL caching systems.
